tickerText: [TENNIS] Saturday in Almaty: Daniil Medvedev tops Terence Atmane 6-4, 6-4, Alexander Bublik saves two match points to beat Karen Khachanov 4-6, 7-6(5), 7-6(5), Stefanos Tsitsipas defeats James Duckworth 6-3, 6-4 and qualifier Nikoloz Basilashvili ousts Adrian Mannarino 6-3, 6-1 to complete the semifinal lineup • [SQUASH] Championship Saturday at the PSA Gold Silicon Valley Open in Redwood City: Sivasangari Subramaniam faces Farida Mohamed in the women's final after rallying past Anahat Singh, while Diego Elias and Mohamed ElShorbagy headline the men's title match after Friday's semis on SquashTV • [BADMINTON] YONEX French Open semifinal Saturday at Arena Grand Paris opens with An Se-young vs Nozomi Okuhara, plus Pusarla Sindhu–Hina Akechi and Feng Yan Zhe/Huang Dong Ping vs Thom Gicquel/Delphine Delrue; Alex Lanier and Christo Popov carry home hopes into the last four • [PICKLEBALL] Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam semifinals at Kai Tak: Judit Castillo and Andie Dikosavljevic reach Sunday's women's final, Tama Shimabukuro and Hunter Johnson set the men's title match after Federico Staksrud's loss, with Johns/Tardio in men's doubles semis • [TABLE TENNIS] ITTF-ATTU Asian Championships Day 4 in Tashkent runs singles round-of-16 and quarterfinals plus doubles quarterfinals at Olympic Town after China and Japan claimed team gold, with Tomokazu Harimoto, Manav Vikash Thakkar and Chun Ting Wong among the men's singles contenders

newsItems.title: Almaty Semifinal Four Set
newsItems.excerpt: Daniil Medvedev beat Terence Atmane 6-4, 6-4 and Alexander Bublik edged Karen Khachanov 4-6, 7-6(5), 7-6(5) in Almaty quarterfinals, while Stefanos Tsitsipas topped James Duckworth 6-3, 6-4 and Nikoloz Basilashvili defeated Adrian Mannarino 6-3, 6-1.

newsItems.title: French Open Semifinal Day
newsItems.excerpt: The YONEX French Open moves into semifinals at Arena Grand Paris with An Se-young vs Nozomi Okuhara leading the slate; Hina Akechi rides a dream run into Pusarla Sindhu after upsetting Putri Kusuma Wardani, while Alex Lanier and Christo Popov keep France in the hunt.

newsItems.title: Hong Kong Slam Semis
newsItems.excerpt: At Kai Tak Arena, Judit Castillo and Andie Dikosavljevic won women's singles semifinals to set Sunday's final, while Tama Shimabukuro and Hunter Johnson advanced to the men's title match after Federico Staksrud fell in three games.

newsItems.title: Asian Champs Day Four
newsItems.excerpt: The ITTF-ATTU Asian Championships in Tashkent shift to individual knockout play with men's and women's singles round-of-16 and quarterfinals plus doubles quarterfinals, following China's men's team title and Japan's women's team win earlier in the week.
